beats.summary: Dwight announces a fake accident and branch closing, causing confusion and concern among the office staff.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Excuse me! May I have your attention please? There has been an accident on 84 West.

beats.summary: Michael initiates a public speaking exercise where everyone will make toasts to overcome fear of public speaking.

evidence.snippet: Michael: As your leader and your friend, I sort of demand that you can all speak in public as I can…

beats.summary: Jim seeks travel advice from coworkers, receiving humorous and serious suggestions.

evidence.snippet: Jim: So. Uh… I am going on a trip. But not really sure where I'm going yet.
Creed: I'd send you to Hong Kong.

beats.summary: Dwight struggles with public speaking and is coached by Jim on how to be more passionate and authoritative.

evidence.snippet: Jim: The great speakers throughout history were not joke tellers. They were people of passion.

beats.summary: Michael covers for Dwight during his speech, delivering a humorous talk about excellence and humor in the workplace.
